entities.name: Kirri
entities.description: A young cactusfolk druid of Thunder Junction, companion of Yuma, who reinforced the burning bar with vines.

entities.name: Yuma
entities.description: Kirri's companion who took him in and opened a bar.

entities.name: Elnor
entities.description: Yuma's old friend who tracked him down and confronted him.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane where Kirri and Yuma live.

events.summary: Yuma arrives in Thunder Junction, finds a newborn Kirri and takes him under his care.
events.quote: Yuma encountered a newborn Kirri and took him under his care

events.summary: Elnor confronts Yuma and their shootout sets Yuma's bar on fire.
events.quote: Their shootout resulted in much of Yuma's bar being consumed by fire

events.summary: Kirri reinforces the bar with interlacing vines bearing massive red flowers.
events.quote: Kirri intervened by reinforcing the building with intricate, interlacing vines

relations.quote: Kirri is a young cactusfolk and companion of Yuma
